tei:div.tei:p: (ca)༄༅// 'phags ma 'od zer can ma'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang man ngag dang bcas pa bzhugs so// ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya mā rī ts+yai sā dha naṃ/ bod skad du/ 'phags ma 'od zer can gyi sgrub pa'i thabs/ 'phags ma 'od zer can la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gi ming tsam dran pas kyang*// sdug bsngal kun las thar bar byed// 'od zer can la phyag 'tshal nas// de yi sgrub pa'i rim pa bshad// rang gi snying ga'i dbus gnas pa'i// zla ba'i dkyil 'khor steng du ni// mām̐ gyi yi ge bsam par bya// de yi 'od zer snang ba yis// bde gshegs sras bcas spyan drangs la// yan lag bdun pa sngon 'gro bas// tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi bsgom par bya// kun tu stong par bsams nas ni// mām̐ gyi yi ge gyur pa las// rin chen las grub shing rta'i dbyibs// phag gis drangs pa'i steng du ni// sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte ba la// 'phags ma gser gyi mdog lta bu// g.yas brkyang skyil krung tshul gyis gnas// zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yon pa yis// mya ngan med pa'i shing 'dzin cing*// g.yas pas mchog sbyin phyag rgya can// zhi dang 'dzum dang sgeg pa'i tshul// lang tsho la babs lus rgyas pa// rin po che yi rgyan gyis spras// dar gyi na bzas rab tu g.yogs// de yi gnas gsum byin brlabs nas// ye shes 'khor los brtan par bya// dbang bskur rigs kyi bdag po ni// rnam snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan pa'o// de yi thugs kar zla ba yi// dbus su mām̐ gyi yi ge la// sngags kyi phreng bas bskor bar bsam// oṃ mā rī ts+yai mām̐ swā hā/ ji srid mi skyo'i bar du bzlas// gal te skyo bar gyur na des// nyi ma zla bar mngon phyogs te// de yi mdun gnas bcom ldan ma// mchod nas thugs rgyud bskul ba'i phyir// 'di yi gzungs ni bklag bya zhing*// gtor ma yis kyang mnyes byas la// 'dod don gsal ba gdab par bya// phyir zlog pa dang 'khrul 'khor dang*// bum pa'i cho ga gzhan du gsal// bkra shis pa dang tshe ring zhing*// 'dod don gang de 'grub par 'gyur// dgra las rnam par rgyal ba'i gsung*// rin chen grags pa las brgyud pa// bla ma'i zhal las rnyed pa 'di// blo dman gzhan la phan pa'i phyir// bdag gis kun tu gsal bar byas// de las byung ba'i dge ba des// phyi dang nang gi 'tshe ba yi// bar du gcod pa kun bsal nas// thub pa'i 'byor pa thob par shog

/tshul 'di blo gros thogs med pa// chos kyi rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa po// lus can kun gyi dge legs dpal// bdag gi bla ma bzang pos mdzad// gang gi mtshan tsam 'dzin cing dran pas kyang*// 'jigs pa kun las rab tu skyob byed cing*// dri med bde ba nye bar stsol mdzad ma// lha mo 'od zer can la phyag 'tshal lo// ༈ /'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs bstod pa dang bcas pa bzhugs/ lha mo 'od zer can ma sgrub pa'i thabs/ rje btsun ma 'od zer can la phyag 'tshal lo// phrin las 'od kyis gdul bya yi// dpal yon me tog rgyas mdzad pa// 'od zer can la phyag 'tshal nas// de yi sgrub thabs bshad par bya// de la lha mo 'od zer can bsgrub par 'dod pa'i gang zag gis khrus dang gtsang sbra sngon du 'gro bas/ stan bde ba la skyil mo krung gis 'dug la/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la lan gsum du skyabs su song nas/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig snyam pa'i byams pa dang*/ sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig snyam pa'i snying rje dang*/ bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig snyam pa'i dga' ba dang*/ chags pa dang sdang ba med cing 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad mgo snyoms pa'i btang snyoms te tshad med pa bzhi bsgom mo// sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de yi ched du rje btsun ma 'od zer can bsgom snyam du byang chub kyi sems bsgom/ de nas oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes brjod pas bdag dang snang ba thams cad mi dmigs pa'i stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che las grub pa'i byang chub chen po'i mchod rten chen po'i bum pa'i nang du/ pam̐ las pad+ma a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bh+rūṃ dkar po las 'od zer 'phros sems can thams cad kyi don byas/ tshur 'dus nas yongs su gyur pa las/

rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dkar po byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya mdzad pa rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang*/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus spras shing rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ dar sna tshogs pa'i na bzas bklubs par bsams pa'i thugs kar rang gi shes pa mām̐ las mya ngan med pa'i shing mām̐ gyis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros pas 'phags pa mchod sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus nas yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid 'od zer can ma phag bdun gyis drangs pa'i gser gyi shing rta'i steng du pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la zhabs g.yas cung zad brkyang ba'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa/ sku mdog ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma g.yas pas mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon pas mya ngan med pa'i shing thugs kar 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan cing*/ dar sna tshogs pa'i na bza' can/ shin tu mdzes pa/ 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phro bar bsams pa'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying gar hūm̐ sngon po/ snying gi nang du mām̐ ser po bsam/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas 'og min nas 'od zer can ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pas bskor ba spyan drangs/ oṃ mā rī ts+yai sarba bud+dha bo dhi satwā ya/ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā la sogs bas mchod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta mā rī ts+yai sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes rang la gnyis su med par bstim/ yang 'od zer 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga spyan drangs snga ma bzhin mchod nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka la sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus dbang bskur bas dri ma thams cad dag chu lhag ma yar lud pas rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan par bsam/

de la sems gtad de yid mnyam par bzhag sngags bzla bar 'dod na snying gi nang gi mām̐ gyi mtha' mar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rgyud bskul nas byin gyis rlob par bsam zhing*/ oṃ mā rī ts+yai mām̐ swā hā/ zhes yang snying ci nus pa bzla'o// grangs kyi bsnyen pa ni 'bum phrag bdun cu ste/ de snyed bzlas na las rnams 'grub par 'gyur ba nyid do// gzhan yang*/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ pa tā kra ma si la sogs pa'i rtsa ba'i sngags dang*/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ pa tā li la sogs pa'i snying po'i sngags dang*/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ ā lo tā lo la sogs pa'i las kyi sngags rnams gang mos pa la ci nus pa bzla bar bya'o// bzlas pa tshar ba dang rang la bstims pa'i ye shes pa phyung nas mdun gyi nam mkhar dmigs pa la mchod pas mchod nas bzod par gsol te/ oṃ badz+ra muḥs gshegs su gsol la/ rang dam tshig pa'i nga rgyal gyis spyad do// 'di'i mdo 'don par 'dod na/ thog mar nyi ma dang zla ba gang shar ba'i phyogs su phyogs te/ der 'od zer can ma mngon sum ltar dmigs pa la mchod cing bstod nas gsol ba gdab pa'i phyir gzungs bton pas bcom ldan 'das ma'i phyag g.yas pa brkyangs pa/ bdag gi spyi bor bzhag ste bar du gcod pa thams cad bsal nas byin gyis rlob par bsam zhing*/ 'di'i mdo ji tsam nus pa gdon par bya'o// mthar yang mchod cing bstod nas/ dge ba'i rtsa ba rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su bsngo'o// gtor ma gtang bar 'dod pas dkar gtor bshams pa sbyangs la/ oṃ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ las kha dog dang dri dang ro dang nus pa phun sum tshogs pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por bskyed la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlab bo// de nas rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye ba'i phyag rgyas/

gtor ma phul bar gsol nas byin gyis brlab par bsam zhing*/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ ba ra li ba dā li bit+tā li bā rā ha mu khi sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ pra duṣ+ṭāṃ pra tuṣ+ṭhā nāṃ tsak+ṣurmu khaṃ ban+dha ban+dha dzam+bha ya/ stam+bha ya/ mo ha ya/ i daṃ pa liṃ gṛh+ṇa pa ya gṛh+ṇa pa ya swā hā/ zhes lan bdun gyis phul nas/ ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod la/ gang gi mtshan tsam 'dzin cing dran pas kyang*// 'jigs pa kun las rab tu skyob byed cing*// dri med bde chen nye bar stsol mdzad pa// lha mo 'od zer can la phyag 'tshal lo// phag bdun gyis drangs rin chen shing rta'i khrir// pad+ma zla ba'i gdan la bder bzhugs shing*// zhal gcig phyag gnyis gser bzang mdog mtshungs pa// bcom ldan 'od zer can la phyag 'tshal lo// phyag g.yas gdul bya rnams la mchog stsol zhing*// g.yon pas mya ngan med pa'i shing 'dzin pa// sna tshogs rgyan gyis brgyan cing dgyes dgur spyod// bcom ldan 'od zer can la phyag 'tshal lo// khyod kyi gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu yis// rnam par brgyan pas chos tshul kun sgrogs shing*// sngags tshul du mas dngos grub kun stsol ba// chos sngags yi ger 'phrul la phyag 'tshal lo// gdod nas rnam dag spros pa nyer zhi yang*// mkhyen dang brtse bas kun nas rab rtsen zhing*// gdul bya'i yid la sna tshogs kun 'jug pa'i// ye shes lnga yi thugs la phyag 'tshal lo// bdag gis khyod sku dran zhing sngags bzlas te// rtse gcig gus pa'i yid kyis gsol 'debs kyi// bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi ba dang*// srid zhi'i dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol// zhes bstod cing gsol ba gdab bo// de nas oṃ badz+ra muḥzhes brjod pas/ bdag la 'dod pa'i don thams cad gnang nas gshegs par bsam mo// tshul 'di la rtag tu rnal 'byor du byas na/ gnas skabs su bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi zhing bsam pa thams cad chos bzhin 'grub par 'gyur ro// 'od zer can ma'i sgrub thabs 'di// byas pa'i bsod nams 'od zer gyis// 'od zer can du bdag gyur nas// 'gro ba'i snang ba byed par shog

/'di'i brgyud pa'i rim pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ dze tā ri pa/ mya ngan med pa'i dpal rdo rje gdan pa/ dharma shrī/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ chos rje sa skya pa/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun chen po/ chos kyi rje paṇ+ḍi ta/ 'phags pa rnams so// mya ngan med pa'i 'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs 'di ni rang gi slob ma lo tsā ba saṃ gha zhes bya bas bskul ba'i don du/ 'phags pas sa mo yos bu'i lo/ dbyar zla 'bring po'i tshes nyi shu gcig la/ chu mig dpal gyi sde chen du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni a ma la shrī'o// ༈ /chom rkun gyi 'jigs pa las srung ba'i 'od zer can ma'i sgrub thabs shin tu zab pa gnas gsar ba 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gis mdzad pa bzhugs so// sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma lan gsum/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du mām̐ ser po las mya ngan med pa'i shing mām̐ gyis mtshan pa las lha mo 'od zer can ma sku mdog ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yas mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon mya ngan med pa'i shing gi yal ga bsnams pa/ phag pa ser po'i rgyab tu pad zla la 'gying bag gis bzhugs pa/ lang tsho gzhon shing rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i mām̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa' dbang lha dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ rigs lngas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan/ ār+yā mā rī ts+yai ar+ghaṃ sogs/ gang gi mtshan tsam 'dzin cing dran pas kyang*// 'jigs pa kun las myur du skyob mdzad cing*// dri med bde ba chen po stsol mdzad pa'i// lha mo 'od zer can la phyag 'tshal lo// rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer can skems shing grims pa phyag na khab skud thogs pa dpag tu med pa 'phros/

rang la gnod par sems pa thams cad rang dbang med par bkug kha mig thams cad btsems/ lus dang yan lag bcings nas 'gul bskyod mi shes par byas par bsam/ rgyang ring du bskyur ba dang gdan gyi phag de las phag ser po mang po 'phros/ dgra bo de chom chom zos/ ro ma rnams kyang phag pas brdzi bcag byas/ gser gyi sa gzhi la thug par mnan par bsams nas/ oṃ mā rī ts+yai mām̐ swā hā/ zhes ci nus bzlas/ slar yang*/ oṃ mā rī ts+yai ar+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da āḥhūm̐ gi bar gyis mchod/ gang gi mtshan tsam sogs kyis bstod/ bcom ldan 'das mas bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa dgra dang bgegs thams cad las rgyal bar mdzad du gsol/ 'jigs pa thams cad las bskyab tu gsol/ zhes brjod/ gtor ma chu gtsang gis bran/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlab/ gtor mgron spyan drang*/ oṃ mā rī ts+yai i daṃ la liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum gyis phul/ gong bzhin mchod cing bstod la gsol ba gdab/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /'od zer can ma 'grub gyur nas// zhes sogs bsngo ba smon lam gang shes brjod/ dpe cha 'di bzang bzang mo byas 'dug tshad la ston na ma hā kā las bzhes shig /maṅga laṃ// ༈ /nyi ma shar ma thag shar ro// shar ro// dpal shar ro// lha shar ro// skyid pa'i nyi ma shar ro// lha mo 'od zer can ma shar ro// oṃ mā rī ts+yai mām̐ swā hā/ lan bdun bzlas/ gang gi mtshan tsam 'dzin cing dran pas kyang nas/ 'od zer can la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes brjod pas nyin zhag phrug gcig gi 'jigs pa las rgyal bar 'gyur ro// zhes rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan gyi gsung rgyun las byung ba'o// ༈ /oṃ swa sti/ lha mo 'od zer can ma'i rjes gnang bya bar 'dod pas stegs ji ltar rigs par/ tshom bu gcig dkar gtor/ mchod pa bcas bsham/ mchod pa byin rlabs sgrub thabs brgya rtsa ltar bya/ bdag bskyed 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gis mdzad pa ltar bzlas pa mchod bstod rnams grub nas tshom bu yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed/

mchod pa byin rlabs mtshan sngags re re sbyar ba'i mchod pa bstod pa 'dod gsol bcas/ gtor ma chu gtsang gis bran la sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba bzhin 'bul/ mchod bstod gsol btab bya/ mdun bskyed la dmigs pa'i bzlas pa cung zad tsam bya/ slob ma rnams khrus byas gral la 'khod nas sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i chings sbyar la rjes gnang bya/ mjug rjes chog sogs rjes gnang spyi ltar ro// zhes pa 'di'ang sa stag lor mdo khams sde dge phyogs su 'gro dgos skabs lha mo 'od zer can ma'i rjes gnang gi yig cha zhig sngar yod kyang lag 'byor zhig ma byung bar brten nam mkha' legs pas 'phral du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni bsod dbang gis bgyis pa maṅgalaṃ// ༈ /'od zer can ma'i sgrub thabs gzungs mdo dang bcas pa thun mong ma yin pa bzhugs so// skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas 'di ltar/ rang gi snying gar snang byed

nyin mo nyi ma dang*/ mtshan mo zla ba bsam dgos/ snga dro shar dang*/ dgongs mo nub tu kha phyogs nas byed dgos/ dkyil 'khor la/ oṃ yig dkar po de las 'od zer 'phros// rang nyid rnam snang dkar po ngur smrig gi /cha byad dang ldan byang chub mchog skabs 'dir rang gi snying gar byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya bca'/ rgya can// ba spu'i bu ga nas 'phros 'od zer gyis// rwa ba dkar po zlum po rtse mo ni// mchod rten dbyibs can rgyan gyis mdzes pa dang*// snying gar snang byed gdan la mām̐ yig las// mya ngan med kyi yig ge mām̐ gyis mtshan// yongs su gyur pas 'od zer can ma ni// gser mdog skems pa'i lus can phyag gnyis kyi// g.yas pas khab dang g.yon pas skud pa bsnams// mnyam par bzhengs pa sna bug g.yas nang nas// phyir spros mdun du bzhugs pa de nyid las// rang 'dra'i pho nya dpag med sprul pa yis// gnod byed dgra rnams dbang med bkug byas te// kha mig btsems shing yan lag bcings gyur nas// rwa ba'i phyi rol 'obs su 'phangs par gyur// rgya gar skad du/ ār+yā mā rī tsī nā ma dhā ra ṇī/ bod skad du/ 'phags ma 'od zer can zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das mnyan du yod pa na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyis kun dga' rwa ba na/ dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po brgya phrag phyed dang bcu gsum dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mang po dag dang thabs cig tu bzhugs te/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag lha mo 'od zer can zhes bya ba zhig yod de/ de nyi ma dang*/ zla ba'i mdun dang mdun nas 'gro ste/ de bltar med/ gzung du med/ bcing du med/ dgag tu med/ brgal du med/

rmongs par byar med/ chad pas gcad du med/ mgo breg tu med/ gzhur med/ tshig par byar med/ dgra'i dbang du mi 'gro'o// dge slong dag gang gis kyang lha mo 'od zer can de'i ming shes pa de'ang bltar med/ gzung du med/ bcing du med/ dgag tu med/ brgal du med/ rmongs par byar med/ chad pas gcad du med/ mgo breg tu med/ gzhur med/ tshig par byar med/ de dgra'i dbang du 'gro bar mi 'gyur ro// de ltar bdag gis kyang lha mo 'od zer can gyi ming shes kyis bdag kyang bltar med par gyur cig gzung du med par gyur cig bcing du med par gyur cig dgag tu med par gyur cig brgal du med par gyur cig rmongs par byar med par gyur cig chad pas gcad du med par gyur cig mgo breg tu med par gyur cig gzhur med par gyur cig tshig par byar med par gyur cig dgra'i dbang tu mi 'gro bar gyur cig de la gsang sngags kyi tshig ni 'di rnams yin no// tad+ya thā/ oṃ pa tā kra ma si/ pa rā kra ma si/ u da ya ma si/ ni ra ma si/ arkaka ma si/ markaka ma si/ u ra ma ma si/ ba na ma si/ gu la ma ma si/ tsī ba ra ma si/ ma hā tsī ba ra ma si/ an tar dh+waṃ na ma si swā hā/ oṃ lha mo 'od zer can bdag lam du skyobs shig bdag lam log pa las skyobs shig bdag skye bo'i 'jigs pa las skyobs shig bdag rgyal po'i 'jigs pa las skyobs shig bdag glang po che'i 'jigs pa las skyobs shig bdag chom rkun gyi 'jigs pa las skyobs shig bdag klu'i 'jigs pa las skyobs shig bdag seng ge'i 'jigs pa las skyobs shig bdag stag gi 'jigs pa las skyobs shig bdag me'i 'jigs pa las skyobs shig bdag chu'i 'jigs pa las skyobs shig bdag sbrul gyi 'jigs pa las skyobs shig bdag dug gi 'jigs pa las skyobs shig bdag phyir rgol ba dang*/ dgra thams cad las skyobs shig 'khrugs pa dang*/ ma 'khrugs pa dang*/ nyams pa dang ma nyams pa thams cad du'ang bdag seng ge las srungs shig

bdag stag las srungs shig bdag klu las srungs shig bdag sbrul las srungs shig swā hā/ bdag 'jigs pa thams cad dang*/ gnod pa dang*/ nad 'go ba dang*/ 'khrugs pa thams cad las srungs shig srungs shig na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ ā lo/ tā lo kā lo/ sats+tsha lo sa ma pa mū ra dhi ṭi rak+ṣa rak+ṣa māṃ/ bdag dang sems can thams cad la/ 'tshe ba dang*/ 'jigs pa dang*/ nad thams cad las srungs shig swā hā/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// lha mo 'od zer can gyi snying po brjod par bya ste/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ bat+tā li/ ba dā li/ ba rā li/ bā rā ha mu khi/ sarba duṣ+ṭā/ pra ṣ+ṭā n+waṃ/ tsak+ṣur mu khaṃ ban+dha ban+dha/ ban+dha/ mu khaṃ/ dzi bha ya/ staṃ bha ya/ mo ha ya swā hā/ oṃ mā rī ts+yai swā hā/ oṃ ba rā li/ pa dā li/ bat+tā lī/ bā rā hamu khi/ sarba duṣ+ṭā nāṃ/ pra duṣ+ṭā nāṃ/ tsak+ṣur mu khaṃ ban+dha ban+dha swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ dge slong de dag dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' de dag dang*/ thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de dag dang*/ lha dang mi dang lha ma yin dang*/ dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten yi rangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// 'phags ma 'od zer can zhes bya ba'i gzungs rdzogs so// zhes gzungs tshar gcig dang*/ slar yang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// lha mo 'od zer can gyi snying po brjod par bya ste/ tad+ya tha/ nas bhan+dha swā hā'i bar lan bdun brjod/ de nas phyag rgya ci bde bar byas te/ nang du 'jug pa'i rlung dang lhan cig tu// 'od zer can ma sna bug g.yon nas zhugs// snying gar thim pa yongs su gyur pa las// rang nyid lha mo 'od zer can ma ni// gser mdog sgeg mdzes phyag g.yas mchog sbyin dang*// phyag g.yon mya ngan med pa'i sdong po las// yal ga gcig 'dzin yid tsam khros pa'i tshul// dar dang rin po ches brgyan phag ser bzhis// drangs pa'i shing rta'i steng du rol pas bzhugs// rang dang phag las 'od 'phros phag 'jigs rung*// dpag med sprul te 'obs kyi nang gnas pa'i// gnod byed rnams zos gser sa rwa bar gyur// oṃ mā rī ts+yai mām̐ swā hā/

zhes gang 'grub bzla zhing dge ba bsngo ba sogs bya'o// bla ma rdo rje gdan pa'i man ngag las byung ba 'od zer can ma la brten nas phyi'i dgra dang*/ chom rkun sogs bar chad zhi ba'i thabs nyams su blang ba'i rim pa 'di ni btsun pa blo gsal bstan skyong gis bris pa'o// 'di'i sgo nas srung skud byed na/ skud pa dkar po gtsang ma la rdo rje'i mdud pa nyer gcig btab/ mdud pa re re bzhin dbugs thog gcig la sngags yid bzlas tshar re byas te lha mor bskyed/ slar yang sngags ci nus bzlas te rab gnas byas la gang bsrung ba'i mgul du gdags par gsungs so// maṅga laṃ// ༈ /'phags ma 'od zer can ma'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga 'od zer mtha' yas bzhugs// na mo gu ru mā rī ts+yai/ rab 'byams phrin las 'od zer gyis// 'gro la re ba'i 'bras stsol ma// thugs rje'i bdag nyid can btud nas// 'phags ma de yi sbyin sreg bshad// lha mo 'od zer can gyi bsnyen pa sngon du song bas/ sngags kyi nus pa dbyung ba dang*/ nad dang sdig sgrib sbyong ba'i don du/ zhi ba'i sbyin sreg byed par 'dod pas cho ga byas pa'i sa phyogs dben par thab khung dkar po rgyar khru gang*/ dpangs su khru phyed/ kha khyer sor bzhi bskyed nas/ sor bzhi'i dpangs su brtsigs pa'am bris pa'i mu ran la rdo rje'i phreng bas bskor ba'i dbus su/ pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba la mya ngan med pa'i shing bri bar bya'o// der dri zhim zhing kha dog dkar po'i bud shing ngam/ yang na srog chags med pa'i lci ba gtsang mas brtsigs pa'i g.yas su/ yam shing*/ mar/ til/ zas mchog 'bras/ so ba/ nas/ gro/ sran ma/ dūrba/ ku sha rnams rim bzhin dgod pa ni bsreg rdzas dang*/ g.yon du chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa lnga dang*/ dkar gtor gnyis bsham mo// de nas rang nyid kha shar du phyogs te 'dug pa'i mdun du rdo rje dril bu/ dgang blugs/

ku shu'i chun po brgyad dang*/ dri'i chu bzhag go /sngon du bya ba'i rim pa'o// dngos gzhi la mchod pa/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dhārmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ gis sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ las mchod pa rnams lha rdzas las grub pa'i ngo bo bzang zhing rgya che bar gyur/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shab+da āḥhūm̐/ zhes dang*/ rdor 'dzin/ dril gsil/ ghaṇ+ḍi ra ṇis byin brlab/ bdag dang 'gro ba nas/ dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// bar spyi 'gre grangs ci rigs/ bla ma dang sogs kyang spyi 'gre/ sems can thams cad sogs spyi 'gres/ rje btsun 'od zer can ma'i sgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o// lan gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs tshad med bzhi 'gre/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ bdag dang snang ba thams cad mi dmigs pa'i stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang la bh+rūm̐ las rin po che las grub pa'i byang chub chen po'i mchod rten chen po'i bum pa'i nang du pam̐ las pad+ma/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng tu bh+rūm̐ dkar po las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dkar po byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus spras shing rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ dar sna tshogs pa'i na bzas bklubs pa'i thugs kar rang gi shes pa mam̐ las mya ngan med pa'i shing mam̐ gyis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros pas 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus nas yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid 'od zer can ma phag bdun gyis drangs pa'i gser gyi shing rta'i steng du pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la zhabs g.yas cung zad brkyangs pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa/

sku mdog ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma g.yas pa mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon pas mya ngan med pa'i shing thugs kar 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan cing*/ dar sna tshogs pa'i na bza' can/ shin tu mdzes pa'i 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phro ba'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying gar hūm̐ sngon po/ snying ga'i nang du mam̐ ser po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas 'og min nas 'od zer can ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pas bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar byon/ oṃ mā rī ts+yai sarba bud+dha bo dhi satwā ya/ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin zhabs bsil nas rol mo'i bar 'gre/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta mā rī ts+yai sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rang la gnyis su med par thim/ yang 'od zer 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ pañca ku la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs mtshan sngags sbyar ba gong bzhin/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ga ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus dbang bskur bas dri ma thams cad dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan/ snying ga'i nang gi mam̐ gyi mtha' mar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul nas byin gyis brlab par gyur/ oṃ mā rī ts+yai mām̐ swā hā/ zhes yang snying ci nus pa bzla'o// grangs kyi bsnyen pa ni 'bum phrag bdun cu ste de snyed bzlas na las rnams 'grub par 'gyur ba nyid do// gzhan yang*/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ pa tā kra ma si/ pa rā kra ma si/ u da ya ma si/ ni ra ma si/ arkaka ma si/ markaka ma si/ urma ma si/ ba na ma si/ gu la ma ma si/ tsī ba ra ma si/

ma hā tsī ba ra ma si/ an+tar dhī na ma si swā hā/ rtsa sngags dang*/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ bat+tā li/ ba dā li/ bā rā li/ bā rā ha mu khi/ sarba duṣ+ṭhāṃ pra duṣ+ṭhā nāṃ tsak+ṣur mu khaṃ bhan+dha bhan+dha/ bhan+dha mu kham̐ dzam̐ bha ya stam+bha ya mo ha ya swā hā/ oṃ mā rī ts+yai swā hā/ oṃ ba rā li/ ba dā li bat+tā lī/ bā rā ha mu kham̐ sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ pra duṣ+ṭāṃ nāṃ tsak+ṣur mu khaṃ bhan+dha swā hā/ snying po'i sngags/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ ā lo kā lo sats+tsha lo sarba murti rak+ṣa māṃ swā hā/ las sngags 'di rnams kyang ci nus bzlas la/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes dang*/ bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa mdun gyi nam mkhar byon par gyur/ gong bzhin mchod/ oṃ badz+ra satwa sogs yig brgya lan gsum/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs sh+lo ka gcig oṃ badz+ra muḥye shes pa gshegs zhes brjod/ bdag bskyed do// bsang chu la dmigs nas/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ nyer gcig bzlas la thab dang bsres rdzas mchod rdzas rnams dri'i chus gtor zhing*/ oṃ a mṛ tas ma dag pa bsang*/ swa bhā was stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las rin po che dkar po las grub pa'i thab khung mtshan nyid dang ldan par bud shing gi rtsig pa dwangs shing thogs pa med par gyur/ hūm̐/ zhes lan gcig brjod pas byin gyis brlab/ mchod rdzas dang bsreg rdzas rnams oṃ āḥhūm̐ las lha rdzas las grub pa ngo bo bzang zhing rgya che ba nus pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur/ mchod sngags gong gi mchod pa byin rlabs bzhin phyag rgya bcas/ ghaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi mi dgos/ bsreg rdzas la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ phreng skor sogs bzlas pas byin gyis brlab/ spor lde thal mo'i bar du bzung la/ oṃ ag+na ye dz+wa la ram̐/ lan gsum gyis thab la g.yas skor byas la me sbar/

sngags de nyid kyis mar dgang blug gsum bud shing gi khar g.yas skor du blugs/ dri'i chu dang*/ a mṛ tas bsang zhing*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ ram̐ las bgrang phreng ram̐ gyis mtshan pa zhu ba las/ me lha dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ ra skyes dmar po la zhon pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas pas dbyug gu gsum pa/ g.yon pas bgrang phreng 'dzin pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ khri snyan sa le'i pags pas stod g.yogs dang*/ mchod phyir thogs 'chad pa/ zhi zhing dul ba drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying gar hūm̐/ rang gi snying ga'i mām̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas shar lho nas me lha 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥrdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa'am/ dbyug gu rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya las g.yab pa'i tshul du bya zhing*/ oṃ tshur spyon tshur spyon 'byung po che// me lha drang srong 'byung po'i bdag /bsreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du// gnas 'di nyid du gshegs su gsol// oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi/ zhes pas spyan drangs la thab kyi shar lhor bzhugs pa la/ oṃ ag+na ye pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ gyis pad+ma'i gdan phul/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin shab+da'i bar rigs 'gre/ ghaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi rol chen/ me lha'i lce'i rtse mor rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las/ 'od kyi sbu gu byung ba dgang blugs kyi ram̐ la phog nas mar khu gsol bar gyur/ zhes dang*/ oṃ ag+na ye dī bya dī bya bi shud+dha ma hā shrī ha bya ka bya bah+na ya

'dir spel tshig dmigs bsal yod na ji ltar rigs pa dang*/ med na/ bdag gi nad dang sdig pa dang sgrib pa dang bar du gcod pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes sbyar/ gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skya'i rgyab ri seng ge'i mgo bo lta bu'i mig g.yon mtshon pa'i brag ri zhig pa'i pra rtags ngan pa sogs 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis byon zan dbul lo// de nas rang gi snying ga nas lcags kyu/ zhags pa/ lcags sgrog rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa'i lha mo rnams spros pas/ me lha dam tshig pa la bstim par bsam zhing*/ oṃ e h+ye hi ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐/ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ/ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe hoḥ zhes brjod pas gnyis su med par bstim mo// phyag rgya rnams kun rig bzhin/ yang snying ga'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra mā dzaḥ bdag bskyed kyi dbang lha'i skabs ltar mchod/ gsol gdab dbang bskur rgyas gdab rnams kyang bdag bskyed bzhin la/ 'di la dbang bskur ba zer ba tsam khyad par ro/ ku sha bsang sbyang stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i ku sha sngo ljang rtsa ba dang rtse mo ma nyams pa 'bags pa dang ma dag pa sel ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ zhes dang*/ thal mo'i bar du bzung la/ oṃ ku sha 'di ni bzang zhing dge /sa las skyes pa'i snying po mchog /tshangs pa yi ni dag byed do// dkon mchog gsum gyi dag byed yin// zhes dang*/ oṃ ag+na ye ri pra ngan sogs bar chad thams cad zhi bar mdzod cig las kyi dngos grub kyang stsal du gsol/ oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐ zhes brjod cing thab kyi phyogs mtshams brgyad du dbul lo// mchod yon la sogs pa'i mchod pa rnams gong du brjod pa'i tshul gyis phul nas/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mchog gi sras// me lha'i rgyal po ḍā kis dbang bskur zhing*// shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad bsregs// 'dzin byed med lha nyid la rnam par 'dud// ces pas bstod do// de nas bsreg rdzas rnams/

oṃ ag+na ye gdan sa sogs spel tshig gong bzhin bcas tshar gcig oṃ ag+na ye swā hā lnga/ yang gong bzhin spel tshig sbyar ba gcig bcas khyon bdun/ de bzhin mar nas ku sha'i bar la'ang thog mthar spel tshig sbyar/ bar pa lnga la mar sbyar ba kho na las rdzas so so'i sngags brjod mi dgos so// slar yang mchod bstod gong bzhin byas la/ me lha'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pas gdan sa sogs nas/ bar chad thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes dang*/ oṃ ag+na ye dz+wa la ram̐/ zhes brjod nas/ mar blugs gzar gcig blugs pas/ me lha 'bar ba'i mer gyur par blta'o// 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa'o// me 'bar ba'i dbus su bh+rūm̐ las rin po che las grub pa'i zhes pa nas thugs kar bdag bskyed bzhin/ mam̐ las zhes sogs nas/ gyur pa las bar yang gong bzhin/ lha mo 'od zer can ma nas/ hūm̐ sngon po bar gong bzhin/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas 'od zer can ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pas bskor ba oṃ badz+ra mā dzaḥ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*// bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha// dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i// rgyal ba ma lus 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol// oṃ e h+ye hi mā rī ts+yai sarba bud+dha bo dhi satwa sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod nas spyan drangs pa mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa la/ oṃ mā rī ts+yai sarba bud+dha bo dhi sa twā ya ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes sogs gong bzhin gyi mthar/ ghaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi sogs rol chen/ rdor 'dzin dril gsil bcas/ gang gi mtshan sogs bstod pa 'og nas 'byung ba'i sh+lo ka dang pos bstod/ dgug gzhug dbang lha spyan 'dren mchod pa gsol 'debs/ dbang bskur rgyas 'debs rnams bdag bskyed bzhin la/ 'di la dbang bskur ba zer ba tsam khyad par ro// rje btsun 'od zer can ma la sangs rgyas dang*/

byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ chos skyong ba dang*/ 'jig rten skyong ba thams cad kyis bskor bar gyur/ snga ma ltar byon zan dbul bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ mā rī ts+yai ag+na ye swā hā/ zhes bdun nam/ nyi shu rtsa gcig gis byon zan dbul lo// de nas/ oṃ mā rī ts+yai sarba bud+dha bo dhi satwā ya/ zhes kun la sbyar la/ ar+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da'i bar phyi'i mchod pas mchod la/ ghaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi rol chen/ rdor 'dzin dril gsil gyis/ gang gi mtshan tsam 'dzin cing dran pas kyang sogs/ phyag 'tshal lo// phag bdun gyis drangs rin chen shing rta'i khrir// pad+ma zla ba'i gdan la bder bzhugs shing*// zhal gcig phyag gnyis gser bzang mdog mtshungs pa// bcom ldan 'od zer can la phyag 'tshal lo// phyag g.yas gdul bya rnams la mchog stsol zhing*// g.yon pas mya ngan med pa'i shing 'dzin pa// sna tshogs rgyan gyis brgyan zhing dgyes dgur spyod// bcom ldan 'od zer can la phyag 'tshal lo// khyod kyi gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu yis// rnam par brgyan pas chos tshul kun sgrogs shing*// sngags tshul du mas dngos grub kun stsol ba// chos sngags yi ger 'phrul la phyag 'tshal lo// gdod nas rnam dag spros pa nyer zhi yang*// mkhyen dang brtse bas kun nas rab rtsen zhing*// gdul bya'i yid la sna tshogs kun 'jug pa'i// ye shes lnga yi thugs la phyag 'tshal lo// bdag gis khyod sku dran zhing sngags bzlas te// rtse gcig gus pa'i yid kyis gsol 'debs kyi// bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi ba dang*// srid zhi'i dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol// de nas yam shing thogs la/ oṃ mā rī ts+yai gdan sa sogs nas/ shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā bar gong bzhin spel tshig sbyar ba gcig dang*/ oṃ mā rī ts+yai swā hā dgu/ yang gong bzhin spel tshig sbyar ba gcig bcas bcu gcig gam/ yang na brgya tshar sogs la'ang thog mthar spel tshig bar na grangs gang yod la sngags rkyang pa'o// de bzhin mar nas ku sha'i bar rigs 'gre/

bsreg rdzas so sor phul bas yam shing gzi brjid dang*/ mar gyis tshe 'phel zhing*/ til gyis nad dang bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi ba dang*/ zas mchog gis phun sum tshogs pa 'phel ba dang*/ 'bras la sogs pa'i 'bru rnams kyis longs spyod dang dpal 'byor 'phel ba dang*/ dūrbas tshe 'phel ba dang*/ ku shas bgegs dang bar chad zhi ba'i dngos grub gnang bar bsam zhing*/ zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi rdzas kyi dngos gzhi yin pa'i phyir/ til la bcom ldan 'das ma'i sngags 'ba' zhig gis stong la sogs pa 'bul lo// gal te rbod gtong dang*/ byad stems la sogs pa yod kyis dogs nas/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ bat+tā li nas/ mo ha ya'i bar brjod pa'i mthar pha rol gyi rbod gtong dang byad stems thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes brjod cing brgya'am stong la sogs pa ci rigs pa dbul lo// bar skabs su me gso ba'i phyir bud shing bsnan zhing yam shing dang mar yang ci rigs su dbul lo// de ltar bsreg rdzas rnams phul ba rdzogs pa'i mthar gshegs skyems byon zan bzhin mchod bstod rgyas bsdus gong bzhin skabs su gang bab/ gtor ma a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ rdor thal kha phye ba'i mthar se gol gtogs pa dang bcas/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ bat+tā li/ ba dā li/ ba rā li/ bā rā ha mu khī/ sarba duṣ+ṭān/ pra duṣ+ṭā nāṃ tsak+ṣurmu khaṃ/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ban+dha mu khaṃ/ dzaṃ bha ya/ stam+bha ya/ mo ha ya/ i daṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇā pa ya gṛh+ṇā pa ya swā hā/ zhes sngags bdun gyis phul nas/ mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i mchod bstod gong bzhin/ bcom ldan 'das ma sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad kyis gdan sa nas 'gal rkyen bar chad bar gong bzhin/ sdig pa dang nad dang gdon dang*/

phyi nang gi bar du gcod pa dang mi dang mi ma yin pa'i gnod pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes bya ba la sogs pa 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab pas/ ji ltar gsol ba btab pa ltar gnang bar bsam mo// de nas/ ma 'byor pa sogs/ ces lan gsum gyis bzod par gsol nas/ oṃ khyed kyis sogs dang*/ yi ge brgya pa'i mthar/ badz+ra muḥzhes brjod pas ye shes pa gshegs su gsol nas thal ba cung zad rang gi dpral ba/ mgrin pa/ snying gar bskus nas/ dam tshig pa bdag la thim zhes brjod/ 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa ste dngos gzhi'o// de nas thab tu mar dgang gzar gang blugs nas/ oṃ ag+na ye dz+wa la ram̐/ zhes brjod pas me 'bar ba'i dbus su me lha sngar bzhin gsal bar gyur/ mchod bstod gong bzhin/ bsreg rdzas rnams bdun bdun nam/ nyi shu rtsa lnga re sngar ltar phul la/ byon zan gyi skabs ltar dgang blugs gsum phul nas/ gtor ma oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ ag+na ye i daṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇā pa ya gṛh+ṇā pa ya ma ma sarba pā paṃ/ sarba bigh+nan/ sarba u pa dra bya shān+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/ zhes gsum mam bdun gyis phul la/ slar yang mchod cing bstod de/ me lha'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pas gdan sa sogs nas/ stsal du gsol bar gong bzhin/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs sh+lo ka gcig spyan 'dren pa'i phyag rgya las phyir bskyed de/ bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don// bsgrubs kyis bzhud cig byin za khyod// slar yang dus bzhin ci nas byon// bdag gi las rnams thams cad sgrubs// oṃ ag+na ye badz+ra muḥ zhes brjod pas ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim/ de nas las kyi rjes bsdus te/ thal ba rol mo dang bcas pas chu bo chen por dor la/ dga' ston la longs spyad cing*/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag

/'od zer can ma 'grub gyur nas// sogs bsngo smon bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad brjod/ gal te gzhan gyi don du byed par 'dod na bsgrub bya de nyid la dmigs shing spel tshig kha bsgyur bcas bsreg blugs phul bas de'i don du 'gyur ba nyid do// sbyin sreg gis ni lha rnams tshims// tshims nas dngos grub rab tu ster// gang zhig sngags kyi lhag chad dag /de kun sbyin sreg gis ni dgang*// zhes 'byung bas sngags kyi nus pa 'byin pa dang*/ byang chub sgrub pa dang*/ thun mong gi las sgrub pa thams cad kyi rtsa ba yin pa'i phyir/ zhi ba'i sbyin sreg ji ltar bya ba'i rim pa 'di sbyar ba'o// zhes lha mo 'od zer can gyi zhi ba'i sbyin sreg 'di'ang 'phags pa rin po che blo gros rgyal mtshan gyi gsung rab gsal byed lta bur rnam 'dren dam pa gang gi yang tsha'i tha shal sa skya pa kun dga' blo gros kyis gdan sa skyong skabs/ me sprel gyi lor rgyab ri spun po ri la mtshan ma ngan pa byung ba zhi phyir/ mo lung du 'od zer can ma lta bu'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg dgos pa sogs rim gro kha shas babs dus mgyogs par sbyar ba'i dge bas gdan sa chen po la bkra mi shis pa thams cad zhi nas bkra shis yar ngo'i zla ba ltar 'phel ba'i rgyur gyur cig/ //maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
